title: Psionics team at work on the night of the eight-gon recovery
summary: Jake Barber tells of Psionics team at work on the night of the eight-gon recovery, about after c. 2014 at California desert, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And there was a psionics team working that night.

plain: Jake Barber, a helicopter pilot, says that on a night sometime after about 2014 he helped recover a craft in the California desert. He says a psionics team, people said to use mental or psychic abilities, was working that night, which would suggest such people play a role in finding or bringing in these objects.
